description: The exact revisions Warthog for Switch 2 builds against and the references it was reviewed against. Every pin is a full commit hash; nothing floats. This file is the single authority for dependency versions (AGENTS.md, 'Dependency pinning authority').

upstream.note: The Switch port this repository forks. Its history, authorship and licence are preserved; port/switch/ and `ninja switch` stay unchanged.

chupathingyce.note: The game engine, pinned in .gitmodules at the release v0.9.1a. Fixes the Switch needs that upstream does not have yet live in port/switch/overrides/ and leave this pin alone.

ounce-devkit.note: The Switch 2 devkitPro image and pacman repository this port is built in. Base image devkitpro/devkita64:20260219@sha256:1fc388c3a0d34bd2045a6dadcb1020e069d5f876a187fd705de14b4440c00282.

libounce.note: The Switch 2 platform layer: switch2_rules, cmake/Switch2.cmake, libnx.a and -D__SWITCH2__. Its jitCreate checks envIsSyscallHinted(0x4B)/envIsSyscallHinted(0x4C) before falling back to libkaihen, which is what decides where executable guest memory can live.

kaihen.note: The libkaihen client library installed into portlibs/switch2 (kaihen.h, libkaihen.a, kaihen-jit.o). The kaiHEN environment it talks to is GPL-2.0 and is assumed, never modified.

drako3d.note: Native Ampere (GA10F) low-level GPU API that preserves Deko3D's Dk*/dk::* API, so the Switch 1 renderer is reused rather than forked. Built with GPU_ARCH=ampere.

uam2.note: Ampere SM 8.6 NAK shader compiler defining DEKO3D=200 (Switch 1's UAM defines DEKO3D=100). Mesa 26.3.0 is MIT. Built from pinned source with meson setup build-switch2 --cross-file cross/switch2.cross -Druntime=true for libuam2rt.a.

drakotools.note: Ampere Drako3D test and inspection utilities. Not linked into the program.

ouncevk.note: NVK Vulkan 1.4 and Zink GLES 3.2. Documented contingency only, if Drako3D hits demonstrated hardware blockers; the port ships one production renderer.

dolphin_nx.note: The primary Switch 2 reference for the Drako3D compatibility headers, swapchain and descriptor synchronisation, display and VRR pacing, Nmouse input, CPU Boost lifecycle and exit cleanup.

nx2_platform.note: Adopted subsets keep the file's copyright, SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT header and the attribution comment naming NaGaa95/dolphin-nx and this revision. The nx2_ filenames and their symbols are the upstream helper's own and stay verbatim.

nx2_gameshare.note: Same terms as nx2_platform. Used for the optional GameShare local multiplayer feature only.

bo2_requiem_nx.note: Documents an ILP32 AArch64 guest inside an LP64 NRO with Deko3D on Switch 1 and Drako3D on Switch 2. Its source is not public, so nothing is imported and it never blocks development.
